notes: Added remaining stories to complete API, revocation, testing, and integration coverage for token lifecycle.

change_log.note: Adds explicit revocation capability missing from lifecycle
Introduces API surface for lifecycle operations
Ensures coverage across rotation, expiration, revocation
Connects lifecycle system to existing GPTReader auth flow

stories.title: Token Revocation Logic
stories.description: Implement explicit token revocation capability allowing tokens to be invalidated prior to expiration, including support for immediate deny on validation and audit logging of revocation events.

stories.title: Token Management API Endpoints
stories.description: Expose internal API endpoints for token issuance, rotation, and revocation to support operational workflows, ensuring all endpoints enforce authentication, validation rules, and structured responses.

stories.title: Token Lifecycle Test Suite
stories.description: Develop unit and integration tests covering token issuance, rotation chaining, expiration enforcement, and revocation, including edge cases such as replay attempts and expired token reuse.

stories.title: GPTReader Integration with Token Lifecycle
stories.description: Integrate lifecycle-managed tokens into GPTReader request validation flow, replacing static validation with checks for expiration, revocation, and rotation lineage without degrading response performance.
